interactions.note: The epitope of M75 Fab bound to the M peptide was determined from the crystal structure of the complex. All residues belonging to the hypervariable loops had well defined electron density, except CDR-H3 residues (H100–H104). Other missing residues are N-terminal H: E1; and residues belonging to the constant region CH1 (134-137 and 162-166). On the M peptide, 8 out of 12 residues (P2-P9) could be conclusively traced into well defined electron density map in the antigen binding site. The authors believe that the final crystallographic model represents an average of alternate M peptide binding by its N-terminal segment (PGEEDLPG) and by the C-terminal segment (LPGEEDL), respectively. In the PDB structure, this bound "averaged" peptide has 9 residues and its first residue is approximated with glycine.; Unmapped quantitative response: 3D structure 2.01 angstroms

The binding of epitope specific scFv M75 to the peptide was measured by isothermal titration calorimetry at 25ºC in Tricine buffer.; Unmapped quantitative response: association constant KA 0.00194 1/nM
